pet_notes: Faithful chibi anime interpretation of Amae Koromo from Saki: tiny youthful proportions, extremely long flowing golden-blonde hair, large bright blue eyes, oversized coral-red rabbit-ear hair ribbon, white and soft-pink frilled sleeveless dress with ribbon details, white thigh-high stockings and white shoes, small silver pocket watch on a chain as her permanent signature prop; mischievous prodigy personality, proud and cute. Preserve the same costume, bow, pocket watch, hair length, eye color, face, and silhouette in every state.
